_note: v2.7 35 Phase 2, the pull curve in a group chat. No backend: player lines are /send compact, replies are /sendas (each renders and commits a boundary). Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-35-open-stretch-curve.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice. The start beat is an open stretch (pull_after 3, max_turns 6). Asserts: no objective line in the guidance block at any point; a multi-speaker round counts one player turn; no hook before 3 player turns; the gentle hook from 3; a swipe to an existing alternative keeps the count; deleting a player line lowers it; the strong register at 6. NOT RUN (written 2026-10-07 in a worktree without a lane; owed to v2.7 39 Phase C).

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the sandbox chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s)`); return { cleared: true };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); globalThis.__so35 = { turns: () => rt.getEngineState()?.blackboard.values.player_turns_in_checkpoint ?? 0, block: () => String(SillyTavern.getContext().extensionPrompts?.story_orchestrator_guidance?.value ?? ''), check: (expected, hook) => { const block = globalThis.__so35.block(); const turns = globalThis.__so35.turns(); if (turns !== expected) throw new Error(`expected ${expected} player turns, read ${turns}`); if (block.includes('Objective:')) throw new Error('an open stretch carries an objective line: ' + JSON.stringify(block)); if (!block.includes('Open stretch: there is no task here.')) throw new Error('the open-stretch line is missing: ' + JSON.stringify(block)); if (hook && !block.includes(hook)) throw new Error(`expected the hook '${hook}': ` + JSON.stringify(block)); if (!hook && block.includes('next place')) throw new Error('a hook before pull_after: ' + JSON.stringify(block)); return { turns, block: block.slice(-200) }; } }; const state = rt.getEngineState(); if (state?.activeCheckpointId !== 'road') throw new Error(`the story did not start in the stretch: ${state?.activeCheckpointId}`); return { active: state.activeCheckpointId };

steps.send: We walk on and I hum an old song.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const last = ctx.chat.length - 1; const reply = ctx.chat[last]; if (reply.is_user) throw new Error('the last message is not a reply'); reply.swipes = ['She changes the subject.', reply.mes]; reply.swipe_id = 1; reply.swipe_info = [{}, {}]; await ctx.saveChat(); await ctx.swipe.left(); if (ctx.chat[last].swipe_id !== 0) throw new Error(`the swipe did not move to the existing alternative: ${ctx.chat[last].swipe_id}`); return { swiped: last };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const id = ctx.chat.findIndex((m) => m.is_user && String(m.mes).includes('blackberries')); if (id < 0) throw new Error('the blackberry line is gone already'); await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); return { deleted: id };

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" Owls call all night.

steps.send: In the morning I wash my face in the stream.
